deck: Two missiles and a drone crash in Poland during Russia's biggest attack on Ukraine — PM Tusk calls it an intentional provocation; NATO calls it a grave violation.
headline: RUSSIAN MISSILES STRIKE NATO SOIL

stories.headline: Russian missiles strike NATO soil
stories.summary: Two Russian missiles and a suspected jet-powered drone came down in south-eastern Poland on Friday 20 Nov during a massive Russian attack on Ukraine (400+ drones, 110 missiles; at least 8 killed in Ukraine). A Kh-101 cruise missile fell near Nowy Lipowiec, ~50 km from the Ukraine border; a second missile near Rudnik nad Sanem; a probable drone at Molodycz. No injuries in Poland. PM Donald Tusk called it an 'intentional provocation'; NATO Secretary-General Mark Rutte called it a 'grave violation' of Polish airspace. Polish and allied jets scrambled, Patriot batteries activated. The incident coincided with the Koalicja 26.2 multinational exercise in south-eastern Poland.

stories.headline: S&P 500 sinks 3.7%, Nasdaq goes negative for the year
sources: AP via NPR Illinois / KNKX / Montana Public Radio
stories.summary: Friday sell-off in AI stocks: S&P 500 −3.7% to 6,910.39 (into correction, −10% from Oct 6 high, worst week in 18+ months, 7-day losing streak); Nasdaq −5.28% to 22,617.73 (worst week since 2020, 2026 gains wiped out); Dow −1.93% to 48,147.33. Nvidia −14.01% on a reported SEC accounting probe; Anthropic fell ~10% on its second trading day after the biggest IPO in US history.

stories.headline: World Court finds Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya
sources: Jagran Josh school assembly headlines 21 Nov 2026
stories.summary: The International Court of Justice ruled Myanmar's security forces committed state-sponsored genocide against the Rohingya minority — a landmark judgment delivered 21 Nov 2026.

stories.headline: UK and EU sign deals on food, carbon markets and youth mobility
stories.summary: Prime Minister Andy Burnham signed three agreements with EU leaders at a Brussels summit covering British food exports, emissions trading and a youth experience scheme; the UK will explore even closer ties with the EU.

stories.headline: Cyclone Akvan makes landfall on India's east coast
sources: Jagran Josh school assembly headlines 21 Nov 2026
stories.summary: Cyclonic Storm Akvan crossed the south Odisha and north Andhra Pradesh coast near Gopalpur with strong winds and heavy rainfall; ~300,000 people evacuated; massive rescue operation in Odisha.

stories.headline: Trump, Xi and Putin leave first trilateral summit with few concrete results
stories.summary: The first Trump–Xi–Putin trilateral summit in Shenzhen ended with few concrete results; Zelenskyy called Putin's attempt to 'redraw the world' with his US and Chinese counterparts a failure.
